paper: CypherBench: official direct text-to-Cypher baseline (public benchmark paper)

mapping.paper_step: Provide the public question together with the graph schema
mapping.note: Messages come verbatim from the frozen V22 public input; no prompt engineering and no gold.

mapping.paper_step: Ask the model for one Cypher statement
mapping.note: The adapter classifies the raw reply; it does not rewrite the statement beyond stripping fences and a trailing semicolon.

mapping.paper_step: Execute the produced Cypher on the target graph
mapping.note: Execution is injected by the central runtime; the adapter never opens a driver.

mapping.paper_step: Compare the query result with the official reference
mapping.note: Official scoring stays in the runtime; the adapter only preserves the answer and records the score it receives.

not_implemented_here: HTTP transport, retries and budget accounting (central runtime)
Neo4j graph lifecycle and read-only enforcement (central runtime)
